Compute Neighbourhood UMAP Centroids

Source: R/nhood_umap.R
nhood_umap.Rd

Aggregates per-cell UMAP coordinates into per-neighbourhood centroids

Usage

nhood_umap(
  object,
  nhood_col = "community_id",
  aggregate_fun = "mean",
  result_name = "nhood_umap"
)

Arguments

object

A SingleCellExperiment object with a UMAP stored in reducedDims. Seurat objects must be converted via as.SingleCellExperiment before use.

nhood_col

Character string. Name of the colData column containing neighbourhood assignments. Default: "community_id".

aggregate_fun

Character string. Aggregation function used to compute neighbourhood centroids. Must be one of "mean" (arithmetic mean; default) or "median". The choice affects both the computed coordinates and the names of the output columns (see Value).

result_name

Character string. Key under which the results data.frame is stored in metadata(object). If an entry with this name already exists a warning is emitted and the entry is overwritten. Default: "nhood_umap".

Value

The input object, with a data.frame of neighbourhood UMAP centroids stored in metadata(object)[[result_name]]. The data.frame contains the following columns:

nhood

Neighbourhood identifier.

nhood_size

Total number of cells in the neighbourhood.

mean_UMAP_1 / median_UMAP_1

UMAP dimension 1 centroid, named according to aggregate_fun.

mean_UMAP_2 / median_UMAP_2

UMAP dimension 2 centroid, named according to aggregate_fun.

Details

The UMAP is accessed by name from reducedDims(object)$UMAP and is assumed to have exactly two dimensions, which are renamed UMAP_1 and UMAP_2 internally. If your UMAP is stored under a different name in reducedDims, rename it before calling this function. Centroids are computed using the function specified by aggregate_fun applied to all cell coordinates within each neighbourhood. "mean" produces the arithmetic centroid; "median" produces the geometric median and is more robust to outlier cells at neighbourhood boundaries. If result_name already exists in metadata(object) a warning is emitted and the entry is overwritten.

See also

plot_nhood_umap to visualise the neighbourhood umap

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# --- Mean centroids (default) ---------------------------------------------
sce <- nhood_umap(
  object    = sce_object,
  nhood_col = "community_id"
)
umap_df <- S4Vectors::metadata(sce)[["nhood_umap"]]

# --- Median centroids -----------------------------------------------------
sce <- nhood_umap(
  object       = sce_object,
  nhood_col    = "community_id",
  aggregate_fun = "median"
)
umap_df <- S4Vectors::metadata(sce)[["nhood_umap"]]
} # }
